Ankit-ku-panda/Terrapath-3d-route-planne.title: TerraPath
Ankit-ku-panda/Terrapath-3d-route-planne.summary: 3D terrain routes, cone geometry, and a clearer way to explore the path ahead.
Ankit-ku-panda/Terrapath-3d-route-planne.details: An interactive route-planning prototype with a cone geodesic lab, terrain height-map import, slope-constrained graph search, elevation profiles, and material estimates. Built with plain JavaScript, Canvas, and SVG.
Ankit-ku-panda/Terrapath-3d-route-planne.limitation: An educational and preliminary planning tool; not a validated engineering or navigation system.

Ankit-ku-panda/SAP-ABAP-LocalAI.title: SAP ABAP LocalAI
Ankit-ku-panda/SAP-ABAP-LocalAI.summary: A local development companion for exploring ABAP, with a lightweight browser interface.
Ankit-ku-panda/SAP-ABAP-LocalAI.details: A Windows-oriented local AI assistant with Python application code, model configuration, a file-based knowledge directory, and setup scripts. Designed to keep an ABAP assistance workflow on your own computer.
Ankit-ku-panda/SAP-ABAP-LocalAI.limitation: Models and runtimes need separate setup. Generated code requires review and testing in an SAP environment.

Ankit-ku-panda/Hoyahh-Your-Own-Browser.title: Hoyahh
Ankit-ku-panda/Hoyahh-Your-Own-Browser.summary: A personal browser, a private-search experiment, and a workspace to make your own.
Ankit-ku-panda/Hoyahh-Your-Own-Browser.details: A Chromium-based Electron browser with a customizable new-tab dashboard. A Python search API connects SearXNG and Tor services through Docker, with search controls and a simplified text reader.
Ankit-ku-panda/Hoyahh-Your-Own-Browser.limitation: An early personal browser build. Tor routing does not provide Tor Browser’s full anonymity protections.

Ankit-ku-panda/TouchTalk-Arduino-Project.title: TouchTalk
Ankit-ku-panda/TouchTalk-Arduino-Project.summary: Turning a simple touch into an everyday message, one input at a time.
Ankit-ku-panda/TouchTalk-Arduino-Project.details: An Arduino communication prototype that maps eight inputs to six fixed phrases, Repeat, and Clear. It displays messages on a 16×2 I2C LCD, prints them to Serial Monitor, and gives buzzer feedback. Includes a Wokwi simulation.
Ankit-ku-panda/TouchTalk-Arduino-Project.limitation: A fixed-phrase prototype, not a sign-language translator. The buzzer provides feedback rather than spoken output.

Ankit-ku-panda/3D-Motion-Camera.title: DepthMotion
Ankit-ku-panda/3D-Motion-Camera.summary: Exploring motion and perspective through an offline Android depth-effect camera.
Ankit-ku-panda/3D-Motion-Camera.details: An experimental Android application using an offline depth model and OpenGL to add a motion-parallax illusion to camera frames, photos, and videos. It can export a PNG or record silent H.264 video.
Ankit-ku-panda/3D-Motion-Camera.limitation: A depth illusion rather than stereoscopic 3D. Strong effects can warp edges; physical-device validation is still needed.

Ankit-ku-panda/Arduino-CapaciSense-Touch.title: CapaciSense
Ankit-ku-panda/Arduino-CapaciSense-Touch.summary: A foil pad, an Arduino, and a hands-on look at capacitive touch.
Ankit-ku-panda/Arduino-CapaciSense-Touch.details: A beginner-friendly Arduino experiment using a 10 MΩ resistor and the CapacitiveSensor library to detect touch at a foil pad and control an LED. Documentation connects the basic concept to smartphone touch sensing.
Ankit-ku-panda/Arduino-CapaciSense-Touch.limitation: The reading is a relative timing value, not capacitance in farads. Phone touch controllers use a different sensor architecture.
